header: One capability, one band, media on either side
bodytext:
Rich text on one side, a screenshot or a photograph on the other, and a toggle that swaps them. Editors stack several of these and flip the toggle on every other one, which is how a product tour gets built without a second element.

Up to four supporting points sit under the copy as plain bullets, and one action closes the band.
caption: The image keeps its own proportions at every width.

points.title: Reverse
points.text: Swaps the two columns without touching the source order.

points.title: Featured
points.text: Lifts one row of a stack onto its own surface so it can lead.

points.title: Rich text
points.text: The body is a real editor field, not a single-paragraph textarea.
